title: K.M. Nanavati v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: K.M. Nanavati v. State of Maharashtra, AIR 1962 SC 605
content.holding: Subba Rao, J. formulated the definitive principles governing grave and sudden provocation under Exception 1: the reasonable man test, subjective loss of self-control, and the fatal effect of cooling time extinguishing the defence.
content.relevance: Mandatory citation on Exception 1 to Section 101 BNS.
